prompt:
Educational flat-design concept map — mind map illustration, square 1:1 format. Italian middle school textbook (scuola secondaria I grado), DigComp I level. Central hub: large rounded rectangle "⚡ Elettricità e circuiti", solid fill #E65100, white bold sans-serif label, subtle drop shadow. Five branch clusters radiate from the hub with smooth curved lines. Each branch has a colored pill label and 2–5 smaller rounded child nodes:
  • INNESCA [#5E35B1]: "Elettricità e circuiti"
  • ESPLORA [#1565C0]: "Lo studente applica la legge di…" | "tensione" | "corrente" | "resistenza"
  • SPERIMENTA [#E65100]: "tensione elettrica / voltage (V)" | "corrente elettrica / electric current (I)"
  • AGISCI [#00695C]: "Costruisci una lampada intelligente con Arduino o micro" | "bit" | "Professione futura: Energy Manager Aziendale"
  • RIPASSA [#F57F17]: "elettricità" | "circuiti" | "legge di Ohm" | "Arduino" | "tensione elettrica"
Style rules: white background, all labels in Italian, branch nodes solid fill (branch color) with white text, hub accent stripe #E65100 on bottom edge only, connecting lines 2px curved matching branch color, no photographs, no decorative frames, no gradients, clean radial balanced layout, Inter/Nunito-style sans-serif typography, WCAG AA contrast, flat vector illustration, 1:1 square.
